title: Prime Number Check
description: Check whether a given number is prime. A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.
outputFormat: Print whether the number is prime or not.
explanation: Try dividing n by every number from 2 to sqrt(n). If any number divides n, it is not prime.

title: Reverse an Array
description: Reverse all elements of an integer array without using an extra array.
inputFormat: Integer N followed by N integers
outputFormat: Print reversed array elements separated by space
explanation: Use two pointers. Swap first and last, then move both pointers toward the middle.

title: Palindrome String
description: Check whether a string reads the same from left to right and right to left.
explanation: Compare first and last character. Continue moving inward until the middle is reached.

title: Binary Search
description: Search for a target element in a sorted array using divide and conquer logic.
explanation: Compare target with middle element. If target is smaller, search left half; otherwise search right half.

title: Factorial Using Recursion
description: Find factorial of a number using recursive function calls.
explanation: factorial(n) = n * factorial(n - 1), and factorial(0) = 1.

title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, find the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target.
inputFormat: Array of N integers and target T
explanation: Use a HashMap to store the complement (target - current element) and its index.

title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane's)
description: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
explanation: Maintain current sum and max sum. Reset current sum to 0 if it becomes negative.

explanation: Use two pointers to place non-zero elements at the front.

explanation: The depth is 1 + max(depth(left), depth(right)).

title: Lowest Common Ancestor
description: Find the lowest common ancestor (LCA) of two given nodes in a Binary Search Tree.
inputFormat: BST root and two nodes p, q
explanation: If both nodes are smaller than root, go left. If both larger, go right. Else, root is LCA.

title: Queue Using Stacks

title: Number of 1 Bits
description: Calculate the number of set bits (1s) in the binary representation of an unsigned integer.
explanation: Use (n & (n-1)) to clear the least significant bit until n becomes zero.

title: Single Number

explanation: XORing a number with itself results in 0. XOR all elements to find the unique one.
